verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships a CLI that can run small models locally. The evidence never mentions command-line flags for GPU layer offload or context length. The only documented flag is `--cloud`, and the integrations page says there is "nothing to configure by hand", so custom load settings from the CLI are unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
